items.title: EASL-EASD-EASO Guidance for the Use of Resmetirom and Semaglutide as MASH-Targeted Therapy.
items.abstract: Adults with metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease (MASLD) and steatohepatitis (MASH) are at risk for cardiometabolic complications and major adverse liver-related outcomes (MALO), including cirrhosis, cancer, and liver transplantation. Non-invasive tests (NIT) for hepatic fibrosis, including vibration-controlled transient elastography (VCTE), magnetic resonance elastography (MRE), or enhanced liver fibrosis (ELF) score, can replace liver biopsy to identify high risk for MALO (e.g. VCTE 10-20 kPa, MRE 3.1-5.0 kPa, or ELF 9.8-11.3), in which pharmacotherapy may be considered. Following approval by regulatory agencies, this joint EASL-EASD-EASO guidance provides updated recommendations for the use of resmetirom (80mg/100mg po) and semaglutide (2.4 mg sc weekly) in MASH, covering treatment candidate selection, treatment initiation, monitoring, and discontinuation. Pharmacotherapy is recommended for adults with non-cirrhotic MASH and fibrosis stages 2-3 (based on NITs or biopsy), alongside structured lifestyle intervention and optimized comorbidity management. Therapy selection should be individualized according to preferences, potential risks, and cardio-renal-metabolic profile, including presence of obesity, type 2 diabetes (T2D), cardiovascular, and chronic kidney disease. Semaglutide, a glucagon-like peptide-1 receptor agonist (GLP-1RA), may be preferred in adults with obesity or T2D as well as with established cardiovascular (CV) disease or high CV risk because of its cardiometabolic benefits, whereas resmetirom may be prioritized in individuals without obesity or those already receiving or intolerant to GLP-1RAs. Additional recommendations include structured safety and efficacy monitoring such as nutritional and sarcopenia assessment during semaglutide or use of fibrosis NITs for longitudinal response criteria. Ongoing studies are evaluating long-term effectiveness of both agents to reduce MALO. In adults with MASH cirrhosis, resmetirom or semaglutide appear safe but should not be used as MASH-targeted treatment, until further data establish liver-related benefits.
items.summary_ja: EASL-EASD-EASOが共同で発表した、MASH（メタボリック機能異常関連脂肪性肝炎）を対象としたresmetirom（80mg/100mg 経口）とsemaglutide（2.4mg 週1回皮下注射）の使用に関するガイダンス。治療対象者の選定、治療開始、モニタリング、中止基準をカバーし、非肝硬変性MASHかつ線維化ステージ2-3の成人に対して、構造化された生活習慣介入および合併症管理と併せて薬物療法を推奨する。治療選択は肥満、2型糖尿病、心血管疾患、慢性腎臓病の有無など個々の心・腎・代謝プロファイルに基づき個別化すべきとされている。
items.key_takeaway_ja: 非肝硬変性MASHかつ線維化ステージ2-3の成人では、resmetiromまたはsemaglutideによる薬物療法が推奨される。semaglutideは肥満・2型糖尿病・心血管疾患を有する患者に、resmetiromは肥満を有しない患者やGLP-1RA不耐容・使用中の患者に優先的に考慮される。MASH肝硬変では安全性は示唆されるが、肝関連の利益が確立されるまでMASH標的治療としては使用すべきでない。
items.why_matters_ja: MASLD/MASHを有する成人は心血管代謝合併症や重大な肝関連アウトカム（MALO：肝硬変、肝がん、肝移植）のリスクが高く、規制当局の承認後に初めてこれら2剤の使用に関する統合的な臨床ガイダンスが提示されたことで、実臨床における治療意思決定の根拠となる。
items.study_type_ja: プラクティスガイドライン（EASL-EASD-EASO共同ガイダンス）
items.endpoints_ja: 抄録に明示的な臨床試験のエンドポイント定義は記載されていない。MALO（肝硬変、肝がん、肝移植）が主要な肝関連アウトカムとして言及され、線維化NIT（VCTE、MRE、ELF）による縦断的応答評価が推奨事項として述べられている。
items.endpoint_results_ja: 抄録に記載なし

items.title: Efficacy of Subcutaneous Semaglutide Dose Escalation in Reducing Insulin in Patients With Type 2 Diabetes.
items.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Type 2 diabetes mellitus (T2DM) is a chronic disease that affects nearly 25% of patients in the US Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) health care system. Semaglutide 2 mg has been found to significantly improve hemoglobin A1c (HbA1c) when compared with semaglutide 1 mg in patients who are not taking insulin. The purpose of this study was to investigate the effect subcutaneous semaglutide dose escalation has on total daily insulin dose in patients with T2DM.
METHODS: This retrospective, single-center chart review study was conducted at the VA Sioux Falls Health Care System. The primary endpoint was change in daily insulin dose from baseline to semaglutide dose increase after receiving semaglutide 2 mg for ≥ 3 months. Baseline was defined as initiation of semaglutide 0.5 mg. Secondary endpoints included changes in daily bolus or basal insulin doses, HbA1c level, and number of hypoglycemic events reported.
RESULTS: Sixty-two patients were included. Daily insulin dose changed -5.6% (95% CI, 2.2-14.0; P = .008) from baseline to 1-mg dose initiation, -22.2% (95% CI, 22.0-35.1; P < .001) at 2-mg dose initiation, and -36.9% (95% CI, 37.4-56.5; P < .001) after ≥ 3 months at the 2-mg dose. Mean HbA1c level decreased from 7.7% at baseline to 7.1% at 2-mg dose initiation (95% CI, 0.3-0.8; P < .001).
CONCLUSIONS: There were statistically significant reductions in total daily insulin dose when subcutaneous semaglutide was initiated and further reduction with each semaglutide dose increase. These results support the current practice of prescribing semaglutide to treat T2DM and suggest that when the dose is increased to 2 mg, patients may experience reductions in total daily insulin dose and HbA1c levels.
items.journal: Federal practitioner : for the health care professionals of the VA, DoD, and PHS
items.authors: Halver Alisha, Wiksen John, Larson Aaron, Wegner Amber
items.summary_ja: VA Sioux Falls Health Care Systemにおいて実施された後ろ向き単一施設カルテレビュー研究。2型糖尿病（T2DM）患者における皮下注射セマグルチドの増量（0.5 mg→1 mg→2 mg）が総日量インスリン用量に与える影響を調査した。主要エンドポイントは、セマグルチド2 mgを3か月以上使用後のインスリン日量の変化（ベースラインはセマグルチド0.5 mg開始時）であり、二次エンドポイントはボルス/ベースアルインスリン日量の変化、HbA1c値、低血糖事象の報告数であった。
items.key_takeaway_ja: 皮下注射セマグルチドの増量に伴い、総日量インスリン用量が統計的に有意に減少した（1 mg開始時 -5.6%、2 mg開始時 -22.2%、2 mg 3か月以上継続時 -36.9%）。また、HbA1cはベースライン7.7%から2 mg開始時7.1%へ低下した。
items.why_matters_ja: セマグルチドの2 mgへの増量により総日量インスリン用量およびHbA1c値の低下が期待できることを示し、T2DMに対するセマグルチド処方の現行プラクティスを支持する。
items.study_type_ja: 後ろ向き単一施設カルテレビュー研究
items.endpoints_ja: 主要エンドポイント：セマグルチド2 mgを3か月以上使用後のインスリン日量の変化（ベースライン＝セマグルチド0.5 mg開始時）。二次エンドポイント：ボルス/ベースアルインスリン日量の変化、HbA1c値、低血糖事象の報告数。

items.title: Oral Versus Injectable Incretin-Based Anti-Obesity Therapies: An Integrated Computational and Evidence-Based Comparison of Orforglipron, Semaglutide, and Tirzepatide.
items.abstract: Incretin-based agents are transforming obesity pharmacotherapy, and orforglipron, the first oral non-peptide GLP-1 receptor agonist to complete phase 3 testing, invites direct comparison with the injectable agents semaglutide and tirzepatide. We integrated clinical trial evidence, including the direct head-to-head SURMOUNT-5 trial, independently verified molecular descriptors, a fully specified drug-target-disease network with permutation-tested hub significance, hypergeometric pathway enrichment, and multi-criteria decision analysis (MCDA) across four weighting schemes with formal sensitivity analysis. Tirzepatide produced significantly greater weight loss than semaglutide under randomized, head-to-head conditions (20.2% vs. 13.7% at week 72) and ranked highest under balanced, efficacy-, and safety-dominant MCDA models once a composite ADMET score misapplied to two large peptides was removed. Orforglipron's lipophilicity exceeds the Lipinski ceiling, showing that its oral absorption reflects deliberate chemistry rather than default small-molecule developability; it nonetheless ranked highest under an accessibility-dominant model driven by oral feasibility and manufacturing scalability. These rankings were stable under Monte Carlo sensitivity analysis for three of four weighting schemes, with the balanced model comparatively fragile. Tirzepatide's cardiovascular evidence has also advanced, with SURPASS-CVOT reporting non-inferiority to dulaglutide. No single agent dominates every criterion; treatment selection should match the clinical priority the individual patient weights most heavily.
items.journal: Omics : a journal of integrative biology
items.authors: Sahu Lorika, Nayak Laxmipriya, Tripathy Aakankshya, Ramachandiran Sivaramakrishnan, Gunasekaran Baranika, Lokaiah Tejasri
items.summary_ja: インクリチン系薬剤は肥満症薬物療法を転換しており、第3相試験を完了した初の経口非ペプチドGLP-1受容体作動薬であるオルフォグリプロンは、注射製剤のセマグルチドおよびtirzepatideとの直接比較が求められている。本研究では、SURMOUNT-5試験を含む臨床試験エビデンス、独立検証済み分子記述子、パーミュテーション検定によるハブ有意性を伴うdrug-target-diseaseネットワーク、ハイパージオメトリック経路エンリッチメント、および4つの重み付けスキームと正式な感度分析を伴う多基準意思決定分析（MCDA）を統合した。Tirzepatideはランダム化直接比較条件下でセマグルチドより有意に大きな減量効果を示し（72週時点で20.2% vs 13.7%）、複合ADMETスコアを2つの大型ペプチドに誤適用したものを除去した後、バランス型・効果優位・安全性優位のMCDAモデルで最高順位となった。オルフォグリプロンの脂溶性はLipinskiの上限を超えており、その経口吸収はデフォルトの小分子開発性ではなく意図的な化学設計を反映しているが、経口実現性と製造スケーラビリティに駆動されるアクセシビリティ優位モデルでは最高順位となった。これらの順位は4つの重み付けスキームのうち3つでMonte Carlo感度分析下で安定し、バランス型モデルは比較的脆弱であった。Tirzepatideの心血管エビデンスも進んでおり、SURPASS-CVOTでデュラグルチドに対する非劣性が報告された。単一の薬剤がすべての基準で優位ではなく、治療選択は個々の患者が最も重視する臨床的優先事項に合わせるべきである。
items.key_takeaway_ja: Tirzepatideは直接比較条件下でセマグルチドより有意に大きな減量効果（72週時点で20.2% vs 13.7%）を示し、バランス型・効果優位・安全性優位のMCDAモデルで最高順位となった一方、オルフォグリプロンは経口実現性と製造スケーラビリティに優れるアクセシビリティ優位モデルで最高順位となった。単一の薬剤がすべての基準で優位ではなく、治療選択は患者の臨床的優先事項に合わせるべきである。
items.why_matters_ja: 経口非ペプチドGLP-1受容体作動薬（オルフォグリプロン）と注射製剤（セマグルチド、tirzepatide）の統合的比較により、減量効果、心血管安全性、経口実現性、製造スケーラビリティ等多面的な基準に基づく治療選択の根拠が提供される。特に、MCDAによる多基準比較は、単一のendpointでは判断できない薬剤選択の臨床的優先順位付けに寄与する。
items.study_type_ja: 統合的計算・エビデンスベース比較（臨床試験エビデンス統合、分子記述子解析、drug-target-diseaseネットワーク解析、経路エンリッチメント、多基準意思決定分析）
items.endpoints_ja: 体重減少率（72週時点）、心血管アウトカム（SURPASS-CVOTにおけるデュラグルチドに対する非劣性）、MCDA総合順位（バランス型・効果優位・安全性優位・アクセシビリティ優位の4モデル）
items.endpoint_results_ja: Tirzepatide: 72週時点で20.2%の体重減少。セマグルチド: 72週時点で13.7%の体重減少。SURPASS-CVOT: デュラグルチドに対する非劣性を報告（具体的な数値は抄録に記載なし）。オルフォグリプロンの具体的な減量数値は抄録に記載なし。

items.title: Exploring heterogeneous treatment effects for GLP-1 receptor agonists in patients with type 2 diabetes.
items.abstract: Understanding treatment effect heterogeneity (TEH) is essential to improve care for patients living with chronic diseases like type 2 diabetes. Individual responses to treatment can vary substantially, and identifying the factors that drive TEH may enable increased personalization of treatment and follow-up. In this study, we conduct an exploratory analysis of TEH for glucagon-like peptide-1 receptor agonists used to treat type 2 diabetes. Endpoints are defined using hemoglobin A1c measurements, body mass index, and blood pressure. We use causal forests to conduct global tests for TEH, estimate variable importances to rank candidate effect modifiers, and estimate the magnitude of heterogeneity. Data from three clinical trials are analyzed: SUSTAIN 6 (subcutaneous semaglutide versus placebo, n=3297), PIONEER 6 (oral semaglutide versus placebo, n=3183), and LEADER (subcutaneous liraglutide versus placebo, n=9340), pooled to 13,670 patients after exclusions. Baseline hemoglobin A1c ranks highest among candidate effect modifiers across methods, and kidney function ranks next in the relative risk causal forest; we discuss their clinical implications. The magnitude estimates, however, show that the variation these covariates jointly explain is small. As such, large covariate-driven heterogeneity can be ruled out in these trials, and the average treatment effect provides a reasonable summary for most patients.
items.authors: Keele Luke, Bonvini Matteo, Storås Andrea M, Shirvaikar Vik, Li Haodong, Jørgensen Nils B, Salsali Afshin, Medici Morten
items.summary_ja: GLP-1受容体作動薬による2型糖尿病治療における治療効果の異質性（TEH）を探索的に分析した研究。SUSTAIN 6（皮下注射セマグルチド vs プラセボ、n=3297）、PIONEER 6（経口セマグルチド vs プラセボ、n=3183）、LEADER（皮下注射リラグルチド vs プラセボ、n=9340）の3つの臨床試験データをプールし（除外後13,670例）、因果森林を用いてTEHの全体検定、効果修正因子の重要度ランキング、異質性の大きさを推定した。エンドポイントはヘモグロビンA1c、BMI、血圧で定義。ベースラインHbA1cが最も重要な効果修正因子としてランクインし、次いで腎機能が上位に位置した。しかし、これらの共変量が共同で説明する変動は小さく、これらの試験では大きな共変量駆動の異質性は排除可能であり、平均治療効果が大多数の患者にとって合理的な要約であることが示された。
items.key_takeaway_ja: これらのGLP-1受容体作動薬の試験において、大きな共変量駆動の治療効果の異質性は排除可能であり、平均治療効果が大多数の患者にとって合理的な要約となる。
items.why_matters_ja: 慢性疾患患者のケア改善には治療効果の異質性の理解が不可欠であり、TEHを駆動する因子の同定は治療やフォローアップの個別化を可能にする可能性がある。
items.study_type_ja: 3つのランダム化比較試験（RCT）のデータをプールした探索的二次分析（因果森林を用いた治療効果異質性分析）
items.endpoints_ja: ヘモグロビンA1c測定値、BMI（体格指数）、血圧
items.endpoint_results_ja: 抄録に記載なし
items.sample_size_ja: SUSTAIN 6: n=3297、PIONEER 6: n=3183、LEADER: n=9340、除外後プール合計: n=13,670

items.title: Safety outcomes of semaglutide by chronic kidney disease severity in the FLOW trial.
items.abstract:
INTRODUCTION: People with type 2 diabetes (T2D) and chronic kidney disease (CKD) often experience medication intolerance and side effects that worsen with lower estimated glomerular filtration rate (eGFR). This prespecified secondary analysis assessed the safety of semaglutide by baseline eGFR.
METHODS: FLOW (NCT03819153) was a double-blind, randomized, placebo-controlled trial testing the efficacy of subcutaneous semaglutide 1.0 mg once-weekly on a primary kidney outcome (50% or more eGFR reduction, kidney failure, or death due to kidney or cardiovascular causes) in participants with T2D and CKD. Safety data were collected selectively and included serious adverse events (SAEs), AEs leading to treatment discontinuation, and prespecified AEs of special interest (AESIs). In this descriptive assessment, systematically collected safety data were reported numerically by baseline eGFR.
RESULTS: Of 3533 participants, 1767 received semaglutide and 1766 received placebo. Fewer SAEs were reported with semaglutide than placebo across baseline eGFR subgroups (45.1% versus 50.4% in the 60 or more ml/min per 1.73 m2 subgroup, and 56.4% versus 60.4% in the under 30 ml/min per 1.73 m2 subgroup). SAEs related to infections and infestations; cardiac disorders; respiratory, thoracic and mediastinal disorders; and metabolism and nutrition disorders were generally less frequent with semaglutide than placebo, regardless of baseline eGFR. Treatment discontinuations due to AEs were higher with lower baseline eGFR across treatment groups (60 or more ml/min per 1.73 m2: semaglutide 11.2%, placebo 11.3%; under30 ml/min per 66 1.73 m2: semaglutide 18.8%, placebo 18.7%). Discontinuations specifically due to gastrointestinal AEs were reported more frequently with semaglutide (4.5%) than placebo (1.1%), regardless of baseline eGFR. Frequencies of AESI were similar between treatment groups across baseline eGFR subgroups.
CONCLUSIONS: In this safety assessment, SAEs were reported less frequently with semaglutide than placebo, with corresponding patterns observed for treatment discontinuations and AESIs. No unexpected safety concerns were identified across the spectrum of eGFR represented in the FLOW trial.
items.authors: Tuttle Katherine R, Andersen Margit R, Arici Mustafa, Arslan Ecenur Guder, Bellary Srikanth, Idorn Thomas, Ji Linong, Kamenov Zdravko
items.summary_ja: FLOW試験（NCT03819153）の事前指定された二次解析であり、2型糖尿病（T2D）と慢性腎臓病（CKD）を有する参加者において、ベースラインeGFRによるセマグルチドの安全性を評価した。二重盲検・ランダム化・プラセボ対照試験で、皮下投与セマグルチド1.0 mg週1回の腎臓主要アウトカム（eGFR 50%以上の低下、腎不全、腎臓または心血管原因による死亡）に対する有効性を検証した。本解析では、重篤な有害事象（SAE）、有害事象による治療中止、事前指定された特別関心有害事象（AESI）をベースラインeGFR別に記述的に報告した。
items.key_takeaway_ja: セマグルチド群はプラセボ群よりSAEの報告頻度が低く、eGFRの全範囲にわたり予期しない安全性上の懸念は認められなかった。
items.why_matters_ja: T2DとCKDを有する患者では、eGFRの低下に伴い薬剤不耐性や副作用が悪化することが多く、CKD重症度別の安全性評価は臨床的に重要である。
items.study_type_ja: 二重盲検・ランダム化・プラセボ対照試験（FLOW試験）の事前指定された二次解析（記述的安全性評価）
items.endpoints_ja: 本解析の安全性評価項目：重篤な有害事象（SAE）、有害事象による治療中止、事前指定された特別関心有害事象（AESI）。原試験の主要アウトカム：eGFR 50%以上の低下、腎不全、腎臓または心血管原因による死亡。
items.endpoint_results_ja: SAE：eGFR 60 ml/min/1.73 m²以上群でセマグルチド45.1% vs プラセボ50.4%、eGFR 30 ml/min/1.73 m²未満群でセマグルチド56.4% vs プラセボ60.4%。有害事象による治療中止：eGFR 60 ml/min/1.73 m²以上群でセマグルチド11.2% vs プラセボ11.3%、eGFR 30 ml/min/1.73 m²未満群でセマグルチド18.8% vs プラセボ18.7%。消化管有害事象による中止：セマグルチド4.5% vs プラセボ1.1%（ベースラインeGFRに関わらず）。AESI：ベースラインeGFRサブグループを横断して治療群間で頻度が類似。
items.sample_size_ja: 3533名（セマグルチド群1767名、プラセボ群1766名）

items.title: Dose-Response Profiles in Incretin and Multi-Agonist Obesity Pharmacotherapy.
items.abstract: Incretin and multi-agonist therapies have transformed obesity pharmacotherapy, but dose selection remains less mature than efficacy assessment. This critical narrative review examines nonlinear relationships among administered dose, systemic exposure, weight and cardiometabolic benefit, gastrointestinal tolerability, treatment persistence, and maintenance. Across established and newer programs, average efficacy generally increases with dose, yet incremental gains may narrow at higher exposure while adverse-event burden and discontinuation can increase. The maturity of evidence is heterogeneous, and later-stage programs should not be interpreted as clinically equivalent to agents supported mainly by earlier-phase dose-ranging data. Moreover, an "optimal dose" is not an endpoint-independent quantity: the exposure most appropriate for weight loss may differ from that relevant to glycemic control, cardiovascular benefit, body composition, tolerability, or maintenance. We therefore distinguish nominal dose from exposure and present response-guided titration as a hypothesis-generating framework for prospective testing, not as an evidence-based dosing algorithm. Existing continuation and withdrawal studies support the importance of ongoing pharmacological treatment after successful weight loss but do not establish a minimum or optimal de-intensified maintenance dose. Future trials should jointly model efficacy, safety, body composition, patient-reported outcomes, pharmacokinetics, and discontinuation to test objective-specific, patient-level dosing strategies.
items.journal: Clinics and research in hepatology and gastroenterology
items.authors: Yousefian Mahdi, Baharmast Maryam
items.summary_ja: インクレチンおよびマルチアゴニスト肥満治療薬における投与量・全身曝露・体重減少・心代謝効果・消化管耐性・治療継続性・維持療法間の非線形関係を考察した批判的ナラティブレビュー。既存および新規プログラムにおいて、平均的な有効性は一般に用量増加に伴って上昇するが、高曝露域では増分効果が縮小し、有害事象の負担と中止率が増加し得ることを指摘。
items.key_takeaway_ja: 「最適用量」はエンドポイント非依存の量ではなく、体重減少に最も適した曝露は血糖コントロール、心血管効果、体組成、耐性、維持療法に関連する曝露と異なる可能性がある。応答ガイド型漸増は仮説生成フレームワークとして提示されるが、エビデンスに基づく用量アルゴリズムではない。
items.why_matters_ja: インクレチンおよびマルチアゴニスト肥満治療薬の用量選択は、有効性評価よりも成熟度が低い。後期段階のプログラムは、主に早期段階の用量探索データに支えられた薬剤と臨床的に同等と解釈すべきではない。将来の試験では、有効性・安全性・体組成・患者報告アウトカム・薬物動態・中止を統合的にモデル化して、目的別・患者レベルの用量戦略を検証すべきである。

items.title: Finerenone: A Non-Steroidal Mineralocorticoid Receptor Antagonist and Its Emerging Role in Cardiovascular-Kidney-Metabolic Syndrome.
items.abstract: Cardiovascular-kidney-metabolic (CKM) syndrome represents the interconnected pathophysiology of metabolic risk factors, chronic kidney disease (CKD), and cardiovascular disease, leading to multiorgan dysfunction and elevated adverse outcomes. Overactivation of the mineralocorticoid receptor (MR), via aldosterone-dependent and ligand-independent pathways, drives inflammation, fibrosis, and oxidative stress and facilitates CKM progression. Finerenone is a selective non-steroidal MR antagonist (nsMRA) that exhibits high MR affinity, has balanced cardiac and renal distribution, and minimal off-target steroidal effects, which make it mechanistically different from steroidal MRAs. Large phase 3 trials such as FIDELIO-DKD and FIGARO-DKD in type 2 diabetes with CKD, and FINEARTS-HF in heart failure (HF) with a left ventricular ejection fraction (LVEF) > 40%, demonstrated consistent cardiorenal benefits. The prespecified FINE-HEART pooled analysis showed finerenone reduced all-cause mortality (HR 0.91, 95% CI 0.84-0.99), HF hospitalizations (HR 0.83, 95% CI 0.75-0.92), and the kidney composite outcome (HR 0.80, 95% CI 0.72-0.90), with benefits consistent across CKM components and background therapies including sodium-glucose cotransporter 2 (SGLT2) inhibitors. Recent data from FIND-CKD extend utility to non-diabetic CKD. Various guidelines incorporate finerenone as an additive therapy for patients with persistent albuminuria on maximal renin-angiotensin system inhibition (RASi) + SGLT2i. This review summarizes the MR pathophysiology in CKM syndrome, compares the mechanisms of non-steroidal versus steroidal MRAs, synthesizes clinical trial evidence, safety, and guideline-directed place in therapy, addresses implementation barriers, including cost, and outlines future research directions. Finerenone may fill a critical gap in multimodal CKM management, enabling comprehensive pillar-based therapy to mitigate residual cardiorenal risk.
items.authors: Fischer Kyle G, Beavers Craig J
items.summary_ja: 本総説は、心血管・腎・代謝（CKM）症候群における鉱質コルチコイド受容体（MR）の病態生理を整理し、非ステロイド性MRA（finerenone）とステロイド性MRAの機序を比較した。FIDELIO-DKD、FIGARO-DKD、FINEARTS-HF、FIND-CKDなどの第III相試験のエビデンスを統合し、安全性、ガイドライン上の位置づけ、実装上の障壁（コスト含む）、今後の研究課題を概説している。
items.key_takeaway_ja: FinerenoneはCKM症候群の各コンポーネントおよびSGLT2阻害薬を含む背景療法を問わず一貫した心腎保護効果を示し、多面的CKM管理における残存心腎リスク軽減のための重要なギャップを埋める可能性がある。
items.why_matters_ja: CKM症候群は多臓器障害と不良予後を招くが、finerenoneは最大限のRAS阻害薬＋SGLT2阻害薬投与下でも持続するアルブミン尿を有する患者に対する追加療法として各ガイドラインに組み込まれており、残存心腎リスクを軽減する包括的治療の柱となり得る。
items.study_type_ja: 総説（レビュー）
items.endpoints_ja: 全死因死亡、心不全入院、腎複合エンドポイント（FINE-HEART統合解析の事前指定主要評価項目）

items.title: Tirzepatide for Obstructive Sleep Apnea: Trial Evidence, Cardiometabolic Effects, and Implications for Cardiovascular Practice.
items.abstract: Obstructive sleep apnea affects approximately one billion adults worldwide and is associated with hypertension, atrial fibrillation, heart failure, and stroke. Obesity is its dominant reversible cause, yet positive airway pressure therapy splints the pharyngeal airway without addressing the adiposity that narrows it, and randomized trials have not shown that it reduces cardiovascular events. In December 2024, the United States Food and Drug Administration approved tirzepatide, a dual glucose-dependent insulinotropic polypeptide and glucagon-like peptide-1 receptor agonist, as the first drug for moderate-to-severe obstructive sleep apnea in adults with obesity. We summarize the pharmacology of tirzepatide and the anatomic basis by which weight reduction improves upper airway patency, notably reduction of tongue and parapharyngeal fat. We then review the SURMOUNT-OSA program: two parallel 52-week, double-blind, placebo-controlled phase 3 trials enrolling 469 adults with obesity and an apnea-hypopnea index of at least 15 events per hour, one conducted without positive airway pressure and one during established positive airway pressure use. Tirzepatide reduced the apnea-hypopnea index by an estimated 20.0 and 23.8 events per hour relative to placebo, with concurrent reductions in sleep apnea-specific hypoxic burden, body weight, systolic blood pressure, and high-sensitivity C-reactive protein.
items.authors: Arslan Fatima Safi, Ahmad Rimsha, Frishman William H, Aronow Wilbert S
items.summary_ja: 本稿は、2024年12月に米国FDAが肥満を伴う中等症〜重症閉塞性睡眠時無呼吸（OSA）の成人に対する初の薬剤として承認したtirzepatide（GIP/GLP-1二重受容体作動薬）の薬理学と、SURMOUNT-OSAプログラム（2つの並行52週二重盲検プラセボ対照第III相試験）の結果を総説する。469名の肥満成人（AHI≥15 events/h）を対象とし、PAP非使用群とPAP使用群の2試験で、tirzepatideはプラセボ対比でAHIをそれぞれ推定20.0および23.8 events/h減少させ、OSA特異的低酸素負荷、体重、収縮期血圧、高感度C反応性プロテインも同時に減少させた。
items.key_takeaway_ja: Tirzepatideは肥満を伴う中等症〜重症OSAにおいて、プラセボ対比でAHIを大幅に減少させ（推定20.0〜23.8 events/h）、OSA特異的低酸素負荷・体重・収縮期血圧・hs-CRPも同時に改善した。PAPが咽頭気道を物理的に開存させるのに対し、tirzepatideは気道を狭くする肥満そのものを標的とする初の薬剤である。
items.why_matters_ja: OSAは世界で約10億の成人に影響し、高血圧・心房細動・心不全・脳卒中と関連する。肥満はOSAの主要な可逆性原因であり、PAPは気道を物理的に開存するだけで肥満を解消せず、ランダム化試験で心血管イベントの減少を示していない。Tirzepatideは舌・咽頭周囲脂肪の減少を通じて上気道通過性を改善し、肥満という根本原因に作用する初の薬剤として、心血管臨床実践に新たな選択肢を提供する。
items.study_type_ja: 総説（SURMOUNT-OSAプログラムの2つの第III相二重盲検プラセボ対照試験のレビュー）
items.endpoints_ja: 呼吸時無呼吸低呼吸指数（AHI）、OSA特異的低酸素負荷、体重、収縮期血圧、高感度C反応性プロテイン（hs-CRP）
items.endpoint_results_ja: AHI：プラセボ対比で推定20.0 events/h（PAP非使用群）および23.8 events/h（PAP使用群）減少。OSA特異的低酸素負荷、体重、収縮期血圧、hs-CRP：減少が報告されているが、具体的な数値は抄録に記載なし。

items.title: Finerenone versus Steroidal MRAs in Type 2 Diabetes and Chronic Kidney Disease without Prior Heart Failure.
items.abstract:
AIMS: Type 2 diabetes (T2D) and chronic kidney disease (CKD) markedly increase the risk of heart failure (HF) and death. While finerenone improves outcomes in clinical trials, real-world evidence and direct comparisons with steroidal mineralocorticoid receptor antagonists (MRAs) are limited. We evaluated finerenone versus steroidal MRAs (spironolactone and eplerenone) in patients without prior HF.
METHODS: Using the TriNetX platform, we conducted a retrospective multi-center observational study. We identified patients aged ≥18 years with T2D and CKD without prior HF and ischemic heart disease, who initiated MRAs after receiving a sodium-glucose co-transporter 2 (SGLT2) inhibitor as first-line therapy between 2021 and 2024 (N=3,680). Of these, 724 initiated finerenone and 1,542 initiated a steroidal MRA. After propensity score matching, each group included 551 patients. The primary outcome was all-cause death during the 18-month follow-up period; the secondary outcome was new-onset HF and renal outcome (a composite of end-stage renal disease and dialysis).
RESULTS: Over 18-month, finerenone initiation was associated with lower incidence rates of all-cause death (2.1 vs 4.5 events/100 person-years; incidence rate difference, -2.41; 95% CI, -4.38 to -0.44) and new-onset HF (6.5 vs 12.9; -6.38; 95% CI, -9.75 to -3.02), whereas no significant difference was observed for the renal outcome (8.3 vs 9.1; -0.81; 95% CI, -3.99 to 2.37).
CONCLUSIONS: Finerenone was associated with a lower 18-month risk of all-cause death compared with steroidal MRAs in patients aged ≥18 years with T2D and CKD without prior HF, who received an SGLT2 inhibitor as first-line therapy; however, residual confounding cannot be excluded, and these findings should be considered hypothesis-generating.
items.authors: Kishimori Takefumi, Kato Takao, Iwasaki Yoshihiro, Shimada Takenobu, Tani Akira, Yamaji Ryosuke, Koike Jumpei, Matsumoto Takehiro
items.summary_ja: TriNetXプラットフォームを用いた後方視的多施設観察研究。2021〜2024年にSGLT2阻害薬を第一選択治療として受けた後、MRAを開始した、既往の心不全・虚血性心疾患のないT2D合併CKD患者（N=3,680）を同定した。うちフィネレノン開始群724例、ステロイド性MRA（スピロノラクトン、エプレレノン）開始群1,542例。プロパティスコアマッチング後、各群551例で比較した。主要エンドポイントは18ヶ月フォローアップ期間中の全死因死亡、副次エンドポイントは新規心不全発症および腎アウトカム（ESRDと透析の複合）とした。
items.key_takeaway_ja: フィネレノンはステロイド性MRAと比較して、18ヶ月の全死因死亡（2.1 vs 4.5 events/100 person-years）および新規心不全発症（6.5 vs 12.9）の発生率が有意に低かったが、腎アウトカムには有意差を認めなかった。残余交絡因子を排除できず、本結果は仮説生成と位置づけられる。
items.why_matters_ja: T2DとCKDは心不全および死亡のリスクを著しく増加させるが、フィネレノンの実世界での有効性及びステロイド性MRAとの直接比較に関するエビデンスは限られていた。本研究はSGLT2阻害薬を第一選択治療として受けた患者におけるMRA選択に関する実世界比較効果データを提供する。
items.study_type_ja: 後方視的多施設観察研究（TriNetXプラットフォーム、プロパティスコアマッチング）
items.endpoints_ja: 主要エンドポイント：18ヶ月フォローアップ期間中の全死因死亡。副次エンドポイント：新規心不全発症、腎アウトカム（ESRDと透析の複合）。
items.endpoint_results_ja: 全死因死亡：2.1 vs 4.5 events/100 person-years（incidence rate difference, -2.41; 95% CI, -4.38 to -0.44）。新規心不全発症：6.5 vs 12.9（-6.38; 95% CI, -9.75 to -3.02）。腎アウトカム：8.3 vs 9.1（-0.81; 95% CI, -3.99 to 2.37）。

items.title: Early Changes in Left Atrial Mechanics During Sodium-Glucose Cotransporter-2 Inhibitor Therapy in Heart Failure with Preserved Ejection Fraction.
items.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Conventional echocardiographic improvements after sodium-glucose cotransporter-2 (SGLT2) inhibitor therapy have been reported in heart failure with preserved ejection fraction (HFpEF), but data on novel composite indices of atrial mechanics, particularly the left atrial (LA) stiffness index and the left atrioventricular coupling index (LACI), remain poorly characterized. The authors evaluated early changes in conventional diastolic parameters and atrial mechanics following initiation of SGLT2 inhibitor therapy.
METHODS: In this prospective, single-center observational cohort study, patients with HFpEF in sinus rhythm who were naive to SGLT2 inhibitors received empagliflozin or dapagliflozin. Clinical assessment, laboratory testing, and comprehensive echocardiography were performed at baseline and after 3 months. Echocardiographic evaluation included LA reservoir and pump strain, the LA stiffness index (E/e'/LA reservoir strain), and LACI (minimum LA volume/LV end-diastolic volume ×100).
RESULTS: Fifty patients completed follow-up (70% women; mean age, 63.9 ± 8.1 years). New York Health Association functional class improved and N-terminal pro-brain natriuretic peptide levels decreased significantly (347 [134.8-524.8] vs. 257 [161.3-427.5] pg/mL; P = .007). Left atrial volume index and E/e' decreased significantly (34.6 ± 5.5 to 32.6 ± 5.7 mL/m2 and 12.1 ± 3.2 to 9.8 ± 2.8, respectively; both P < .001). Left atrial reservoir and pump strain increased, whereas the LA stiffness index and LACI decreased significantly (all P < .001).
CONCLUSIONS: In this prospective observational cohort of patients with HFpEF, initiation of SGLT2 inhibitor therapy was associated with early changes in conventional diastolic parameters and LA mechanics. Composite atrial indices, particularly the LA stiffness index and LACI, changed in parallel with established clinical and echocardiographic markers, suggesting that they may provide complementary information for monitoring early atrial remodeling during SGLT2 inhibitor therapy.
items.authors: Altun Selen Cansu, Özyüncü Nil, Akbulut Koyuncu İrem Müge, Tan Türkan Seda
items.summary_ja: SGLT2阻害薬未治療のHFpEF患者（洞調律）を対象とした前向き単一施設観察コホート研究。エンパグリフロジンまたはダパグリフロジンを開始し、ベースラインと3ヶ月後に臨床評価、血液検査、包括的エコー検査（LA reservoir strain、LA pump strain、LA stiffness index、LACIを含む）を実施し、SGLT2阻害薬開始後の通常の拡張能パラメータと心房力学の早期変化を評価した。
items.key_takeaway_ja: HFpEF患者におけるSGLT2阻害薬開始は、通常の拡張能パラメータ（LA容積指数、E/e'）および心房力学（LA reservoir strain、LA pump strain、LA stiffness index、LACI）の早期変化と関連していた。LA stiffness indexとLACIは確立された臨床・エコーマーカーと並行して変化し、SGLT2阻害薬治療中の早期心房リモデリングのモニタリングに補完的情報を提供し得る。
items.why_matters_ja: HFpEFにおけるSGLT2阻害薬治療後の心房力学の複合指標（特にLA stiffness indexとLACI）に関するデータは十分に特徴付けられていなかった。これらの指標が早期心房リモデリングのモニタリングに補完的情報を提供し得ることを示唆し、HFpEFの管理における新たな評価手段として有用である可能性がある。
items.study_type_ja: 前向き単一施設観察コホート研究
items.endpoints_ja: NYHA機能分類、NT-proBNP値、左房容積指数（LAVI）、E/e'、左房reservoir strain、左房pump strain、左房stiffness index（E/e'/LA reservoir strain）、LACI（最小左房容積/LV終末拡張期容積×100）
items.endpoint_results_ja: NT-proBNP: 347 [134.8-524.8] vs. 257 [161.3-427.5] pg/mL; P = .007。左房容積指数: 34.6 ± 5.5 → 32.6 ± 5.7 mL/m2; P < .001。E/e': 12.1 ± 3.2 → 9.8 ± 2.8; P < .001。左房reservoir strainおよびpump strainは増加、LA stiffness indexおよびLACIは有意に減少（いずれもP < .001）。NYHA機能分類は改善（具体的な数値は抄録に記載なし）。

items.title: Real-world observational study evaluating metabolic and kidney outcomes in patients living with chronic kidney disease and type 2 diabetes mellitus with obesity prescribed tirzepatide.
items.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Obesity and type 2 diabetes mellitus (T2DM) accelerate chronic kidney disease (CKD) progression. Tirzepatide, a dual glucagon-like peptide-1 (GLP-1) and glucose-dependent insulinotropic polypeptide (GIP) receptor agonist, has demonstrated metabolic and potential renoprotective benefits in clinical trials. There have been limited reports of the implications of prescribing tirzepatide in a real-world cohort of patients with advanced CKD.
METHODS: This observational study includes a multi-ethnic cohort of 62 adults with CKD stages 1-5 who initiated tirzepatide indicated for T2DM with concurrent obesity in a general nephrology clinic between June 2024 and October 2025. Patients were followed for a median of 21.4 weeks. Clinical outcomes including weight, glycated haemoglobin (HbA1c), estimated glomerular filtration rate (eGFR), urinary albumin-to-creatinine ratio (uACR), blood pressure, lipid profile and insulin requirements were collected.
RESULTS: Tirzepatide significantly reduced median weight (103-100 kg; p < 0.0001), HbA1c (63 [7.9%] to 54 [7.1%] mmol/mol; p = 0.002) and uACR (111-44 mg/mmol; p = 0.008), while eGFR remained stable. Significant improvements were also observed in triglycerides, total cholesterol, LDL cholesterol and total daily insulin dose. Gastrointestinal symptoms and decreased serum bicarbonate were the most common adverse events.
CONCLUSIONS: In this real-world, multi-ethnic cohort, including patients with advanced CKD, tirzepatide was associated with clinically meaningful improvements in weight, glycaemic control, albuminuria, lipid profile and insulin requirements without adversely affecting kidney function. The introduction of tirzepatide to patients with CKD should be guided by a multidisciplinary team.
items.journal: Diabetic medicine : a journal of the British Diabetic Association
items.authors: Carruthers Jack E, Ooi Xi Yan, Goodall Dawn, Reed Jo, Bedi Rachna, McGrath Adrian, Willicombe Michelle, Avari Parizad
items.summary_ja: CKD 1〜5期を有するT2DM合併肥満の成人62名を対象に、一般腎内科外来で2024年6月から2025年10月にtirzepatideを投与開始したreal-world観察研究。中央値21.4週間の追跡期間中、体重、HbA1c、eGFR、uACR、血圧、脂質プロファイル、インスリン用量を評価した。
items.key_takeaway_ja: CKD進行期を含むreal-world多民族コホートにおいて、tirzepatideは体重、血糖コントロール、アルブミン尿、脂質プロファイル、インスリン用量の臨床的に有意な改善と関連し、腎機能に悪影響を与えなかった。
items.why_matters_ja: CKD進行期患者におけるtirzepatide投与のreal-worldでの報告は限られており、本研究はCKD進行期を含む多民族コホートで実臨床のエビデンスを提供する。
items.study_type_ja: Real-world観察研究（非介入的）
items.endpoints_ja: 体重、HbA1c、eGFR、uACR、血圧、脂質プロファイル（トリグリセリド、総コレステロール、LDLコレステロール）、総日量インスリン用量、有害事象
items.endpoint_results_ja: 体重：中央値103 kg→100 kg（p<0.0001）。HbA1c：63 mmol/mol [7.9%]→54 mmol/mol [7.1%]（p=0.002）。uACR：111 mg/mmol→44 mg/mmol（p=0.008）。eGFR：安定（具体的な数値は記載なし）。トリグリセリド、総コレステロール、LDLコレステロール、総日量インスリン用量：有意な改善（具体的な数値は記載なし）。有害事象：消化器症状と血清重炭酸塩の低下が最も頻度高い。

items.title: Real-World Semaglutide Initiation Behaviours in the United States: Impact on Early Treatment Discontinuation and on 1-Year Persistence.
items.abstract:
AIMS: Little is known about how glucagon-like peptide-1 receptor agonists (GLP-1RA) are initiated in real-world settings and whether prescribing behaviours in routine care contribute to the high discontinuation rates seen in practice. We examined prescribing behaviours for injectable semaglutide at treatment initiation and evaluated their impact on early medication discontinuation and on 1-year persistence among US adults.
MATERIALS AND METHODS: Using MarketScan data (2018-2021), this retrospective cohort study identified US adults with diabetes and/or obesity on no prior incretin therapy starting injectable semaglutide. Initiating dose was categorized as low or high (≤ 0.5 and ≥ 1.0 mg/week, respectively); treatment status was followed for 12 months. Medication persistence was estimated using Kaplan-Meier analysis. Piecewise Cox proportional hazards regression assessed early discontinuation risk, logistic regression assessed the odds of high-dose initiation.
RESULTS: Among this cohort of 48 658 adults, 14.5% were started on semaglutide using high doses. The off-label high-dose regimen was associated with decreased 1-year persistence (p = 0.01), and a 25% increase in early discontinuation risk (HR: 1.25, 95% CI: 1.17-1.34, p < 0.001) independently of age, obesity status, co-morbidity measures and cost. Odds of high-dose initiation were increased in the West and South (p < 0.001), for endocrinologists (p = 0.02), for patients who were male (p < 0.001), younger (p = 0.02), with obesity versus overweight (p = 0.002), and for treatment initiation in 2018 compared with 2019-2021 (p < 0.001).
CONCLUSION: Initiation of injectable semaglutide therapy using high doses is common in real-world settings. High-dose initiation represents a modifiable risk factor for early medication discontinuation and decreased 1-year persistence.
items.authors: Belalcazar L Maria, Gao Daoqi, Modi Saman, Meer Aima, Kuo Yong-Fang
items.summary_ja: MarketScanデータ（2018-2021年）を用いた後方視コホート研究であり、米国においてインクレチン療法未使用の糖尿病および/または肥満を有する成人が注射用セマグルチドを開始した際の処方行動（開始用量が低用量≤0.5 mg/週または高用量≥1.0 mg/週）を評価し、早期治療中断および1年間の継続率への影響を解析した。
items.key_takeaway_ja: 注射用セマグルチドの高用量開始は、早期治療中断リスクの増加（HR: 1.25, 95% CI: 1.17-1.34）および1年間継続率の低下（p = 0.01）と関連しており、修正可能なリスク因子である。
items.why_matters_ja: 実臨床におけるGLP-1RAの離脱率が高い背景において、高用量開始という修正可能な処方行動が早期中断や継続率低下のリスク因子であることを示し、治療継続率の改善に向けた介入の根拠を提供する。

items.title: Changes in Muscle Strength Following Semaglutide Treatment in Adults: A Systematic Review With Meta-Analysis of Handgrip Strength.
items.abstract:
AIMS: To systematically review and quantitatively synthesize within-group changes in skeletal muscle strength following semaglutide treatment in adults.
MATERIALS AND METHODS: This PRISMA 2020 systematic review was registered in PROSPERO (CRD420251185935). MEDLINE, Embase, CENTRAL, LILACS and Google Scholar were searched through 20 August 2026, without language restrictions. Eligible studies included adults treated with semaglutide reporting quantitative skeletal muscle strength outcomes, including handgrip and knee extension strength. Randomized, non-randomized and uncontrolled before-after studies were included. The primary meta-analysis pooled within-group changes in handgrip strength from baseline to the longest available follow-up of semaglutide-only arms using a random-effects model. Knee extension strength was summarized descriptively.
RESULTS: Sixteen reports represented eleven studies, all assessing handgrip strength; one small randomized trial also assessed knee extension strength. Ten studies (660 semaglutide-treated participants) contributed to the primary meta-analysis of uncontrolled within-group changes, showing a nonsignificant pooled handgrip strength change (-0.16 kgf; 95% confidence interval: -1.98 to 1.65), with substantial heterogeneity (I2 = 90.8%) and a 95% prediction interval from -5.96 to 5.63 kgf. Duration-stratified and sensitivity analyses were also nonsignificant. Individual study findings were heterogeneous. Certainty was very low.
CONCLUSIONS: Available evidence is insufficient to determine whether semaglutide is associated with changes in handgrip strength because the principal synthesis was based on uncontrolled within-group changes, with very low certainty and significant heterogeneity. These findings do not establish strength preservation or a causal treatment effect. More robust comparative studies with standardized strength assessment and longer follow-up are needed.
items.authors: Machado Luís Guilherme, Siedschlag Schmidt Pedro Henrique, Tasca Petroski Guido, Lopes Costa Geraldo Lucas, Vieira Dos Santos Ribeiro Letícia, Ramos Da Cruz João Victor, De Luca Canto Graziela, Hohl Alexandre
items.summary_ja: セマグルチド治療後の成人における骨格筋力（主にハンドグリップ力）の群内変化を体系的にレビューし、メタ分析で定量的に統合した研究。16件の報告（11研究）が対象となり、うち10研究（660名のセマグルチド治療参加者）が非対照群内変化の主要メタ分析に貢献した。プールされたハンドグリップ力変化は非有意（-0.16 kgf；95% CI: -1.98〜1.65）で、異質性は大きく（I² = 90.8%）、確実性は非常に低かった。
items.key_takeaway_ja: セマグルチドがハンドグリップ力の変化と関連するかを判断するには現在の証拠は不十分であり、筋力の維持や因果的な治療効果は確立されていない。
items.why_matters_ja: セマグルチドは糖尿病・肥満治療に広く使用されるGLP-1受容体作動薬であり、減量に伴う筋力低下の懸念がある中、筋力への影響を評価することは臨床的に重要である。しかし、現在の証拠は非対照群内変化に基づくものであり、確実性が非常に低いため、より堅牢な比較研究が求められる。
items.study_type_ja: 系統的レビュー（メタ分析付き）
items.endpoints_ja: 主要エンドポイント：セマグルチド単独群におけるベースラインから最長フォローアップ時のハンドグリップ力の群内変化。二次エンドポイント：膝伸展筋力（記述的まとめ）。
items.endpoint_results_ja: プールされたハンドグリップ力変化：-0.16 kgf（95% CI: -1.98〜1.65）、I² = 90.8%、95%予測区間：-5.96〜5.63 kgf。有意差なし。期間別層別解析および感度分析も有意差なし。確実性：非常に低い。

items.title: [Treatment of type 2 diabetes mellitus].
items.abstract: Modern diabetology is undergoing a paradigm shift from glucose-centric management toward risk-adapted precision medicine. Differentiated phenotyping into clusters allows for the early identification of organ-specific risks. Pharmacotherapy now prioritizes cardiorenal protection using sodium-glucose cotransporter 2 (SGLT2) inhibitors, glucagon-like peptide‑1 (GLP-1) receptor agonists, and nonsteroidal mineralocorticoid receptor antagonists (nsMRAs; finerenone), which reduce vascular events beyond glycated hemoglobin (HbA1c) reduction alone. Technological innovations, such as continuous glucose monitoring (CGM), complement traditional markers with dynamic metrics such as time in range. A new, realistic therapeutic goal is metabolic remission, facilitated by potent incretin mimetics and early intervention during the prediabetes stage. The ultimate objective is the sustainable restoration of normoglycemia and the prevention of end-organ damage through a multifactorial, individualized approach.

items.summary_ja: 現代の糖尿病学は、グルコース中心的管理からリスク適応型プレシジョン・メディシンへのパラダイムシフトを経験している。クラスタリングによるフェノタイピングで臓器特異的リスクを早期に同定し、SGLT2阻害薬、GLP-1受容体作動薬、非ステロイド性ミネラルコルチコイド受容体拮抗薬（フィネレノン）による心腎保護を優先する薬物療法が主流となっている。連続グルコースモニタリング（CGM）による動的指標（time in range）が従来の指標を補完し、インクレチン模倣薬と糖尿病予備群段階での早期介入により代謝寛解が現実的な治療目標として提唱されている。
items.key_takeaway_ja: 2型糖尿病の治療はHbA1c低下のみならず心腎保護を優先する方向へ転換しており、インクレチン模倣薬と早期介入による代謝寛解が新たな現実的な治療目標として位置づけられている。
items.why_matters_ja: 2型糖尿病の管理方針がグルコース中心から臓器保護・個別化医療へ転換しつつあることを示し、臨床現場での治療戦略の再考を促す。

items.title: Antidiabetic medications in the pipeline.
items.abstract: There is an extensive pipeline of therapies for diabetes mellitus. It has been known for the past three decades that obesity is a key pathophysiological player, involving inflammation, insulin resistance and metabolic dysfunction leading to type 2 diabetes and to significant cardiovascular, renal and hepatic complications, all central to the metabolic syndrome. On the basis of this knowledge and the disposition of drugs with multiple effects on different disease components, the diabetes therapeutic paradigm has shifted from merely glucocentric to multitargeted against these interconnected pathways.Much more recently, incretin-based multi-agonists have been developed that deliver unprecedented glycemic and weight benefits as well as weekly insulins and oral GLP-1 agonists that are able to reduce the burden of injectable therapies. An antibody-peptide conjugate that acts as a dual GLP-1/GIP receptor modulator has also shown promising results. Today, novel insulin sensitizers are modulating metabolic pathways towards higher energy expenditure with fewer side effects. Adjunctive agents for type 1 diabetes are improving glucose control while reducing hypoglycemia risk. Finally, drugs designed to restrain the inevitable muscle mass loss caused by antiobesity treatments are being tested. The diabetes pipeline is rich and there is hope that in the next few years, the therapeutic landscape will be further transformed with even more efficacious and individualized treatments.
items.authors: Efstathiadou Zoe A, Gogakos Apostolos I, Divaris Efstathios, Kostopoulos Georgios, Makri Evangelia
items.summary_ja: 糖尿病治療薬のパイプラインに関するレビュー論文。肥満が炎症・インスリン抵抗性・代謝異常を介して2型糖尿病および心血管・腎・肝臓合併症を引き起こす主要な病生理学的因子であることが30年以上前から知られており、この知見に基づき糖尿病治療のパラダイムは単なるグルコース中心から、相互に関連する経路に対するマルチターゲットアプローチへと移行した。インクリン系マルチアゴニスト、週1回インスリン、経口GLP-1アゴニスト、GLP-1/GIP受容体二重モジュレーターである抗体-ペプチド融合体、新規インスリン感受性改善薬、1型糖尿病の補助療法、抗肥満治療に伴う筋量減少を抑制する薬剤などが開発されている。
items.key_takeaway_ja: 糖尿病治療のパイプラインは豊富であり、グルコース中心からマルチターゲットアプローチへの転換が進んでおり、今後数年でより効果的で個別化された治療が実現する可能性がある。
items.why_matters_ja: 糖尿病治療の方向性が単一の血糖値低下から、肥満・炎症・代謝異常を含む複数の病態経路を同時に標的とするマルチターゲット戦略へと転換しており、心血管・腎・肝臓合併症を含むメタボリックシンドローム全体へのアプローチが期待される。

items.title: Economic evaluation of tirzepatide, semaglutide, and liraglutide in the treatment of obese and overweight patients without diabetes: a short-term cost-effectiveness analysis in Iran.
items.abstract:
PURPOSE: GLP-1 and dual GLP-1/GIP receptor agonists have improved obesity treatment, but their high cost requires economic evaluation to guide resource allocation. To assess the short-term cost-effectiveness of subcutaneous tirzepatide, semaglutide, and liraglutide for treating adults with overweight or obesity without diabetes in Iran.
METHODS: A decision-tree model was developed to compare tirzepatide, semaglutide, and liraglutide over 68 weeks in adults aged ≥ 18 years with BMI ≥ 30 kg/m² or ≥ 27 kg/m² with at least one additional weight-related complication, excluding those with diabetes, from the payer perspective. Clinical effectiveness, adverse event (AE), and treatment discontinuation data were obtained from published literatures. Quality-adjusted life years (QALYs) were estimated based on BMI changes and AE-related disutility. Direct medical costs included drug acquisition and AE management costs. Deterministic and probabilistic sensitivity analyses were performed.
RESULTS: Compared with semaglutide, tirzepatide generated greater health benefits but at higher costs, resulting in an incremental cost-effectiveness ratio of US$34,423.89/QALY. Liraglutide was dominated by semaglutide. Semaglutide was cost-effective at the Iranian willingness-to-pay threshold of US$ (Purchasing power parity (PPP) 15,558.5/QALY, equal to one time GDP per capita in 2026. Sensitivity analyses confirmed the robustness of the findings.
CONCLUSION: Semaglutide was the cost-effective injectable GLP-1-based therapy in Iran. Although tirzepatide provided greater health benefits, its higher cost limited its cost-effectiveness at current prices.
SUPPLEMENTARY INFORMATION: The online version contains supplementary material available at https://doi.org/10.1007/s40200-026-02114-z.

items.summary_ja: イランにおいて、糖尿病を伴わない過体重・肥満成人に対する皮下注射製剤（tirzepatide、semaglutide、liraglutide）の短期（68週間）コスト効果分析を、ペイヤー視点から決定木モデルを用いて実施した。臨床効果、有害事象、治療中断データは公開文献から取得し、QALYはBMI変化とAE関連のディスユーティリティに基づいて推定した。
items.key_takeaway_ja: SemaglutideはイランのWTP閾値（US$15,558.5/QALY、PPP、2026年1人当たりGDPの1倍）においてコスト効果があった。Tirzepatideはsemaglutideより健康利益が大きいが高コストであり、ICERはUS$34,423.89/QALYであった。Liraglutideはsemaglutideに支配された。
items.why_matters_ja: GLP-1受容体作動薬およびGLP-1/GIP二重受容体作動薬は肥満治療を改善しているが、その高コストにより資源配分を導くための経済評価が必要である。

items.title: Dapagliflozin alleviates CYH33-induced hyperglycemia and preserves antitumor immunity against ovarian cancer in type 1 diabetic mice.
items.abstract: PI3K is frequently hyperactivated in ovarian cancer and has emerged as a promising therapeutic target. CYH33 is a novel PI3Kα-selective inhibitor that has been approved in Japan for the treatment of ovarian clear cell carcinoma harboring PIK3CA mutations. However, its on-target adverse effect of hyperglycemia limits its clinical application, particularly in patients susceptible to diabetes, underscoring the urgent need to optimize therapeutic strategies to improve both safety and efficacy. In this study, we employed an ID8 syngeneic murine ovarian cancer model and demonstrated that CYH33 significantly inhibited tumor growth with a modest effect on glucose homeostasis. We then established mouse models of type 1 (T1D) and type 2 diabetes (T2D) to expose hyperglycemia induced by PI3K inhibition and identified that dapagliflozin effectively alleviated CYH33-induced hyperglycemia while preserving its antitumor activity in T1D mice. Mechanistically, the combination of CYH33 and dapagliflozin may improve the immunosuppressive tumor microenvironment in T1D mice, as evidenced by upregulation gene sets involved in interferon-α and interferon-γ response, as well as significantly enhanced infiltration of CD8+ T-cell in ID8 tumors. Furthermore, this combination synergized with anti-PD-1 antibody to further enhance antitumor efficacy. These findings provide a potential strategy for optimizing the clinical use of PI3K inhibitors and shed light on metabolic interventions to modulate tumor immune microenvironment.
items.authors: Sun Jiaqi, Xu Lan, Qu Hui, Zhang Xi, Ma Xiaoyu, Leng Ying, Meng Linghua
items.summary_ja: 本研究は、ID8同種マウス卵巣がんモデルを用い、PI3Kα選択的阻害薬CYH33が腫瘍増殖を有意に抑制し、血糖恒常性への影響は modest であることを示した。次に、1型糖尿病（T1D）および2型糖尿病（T2D）マウスモデルを確立し、PI3K阻害による高血糖を再現した。T1Dマウスにおいて、ダパグリフロジンがCYH33誘発性高血糖を効果的に軽減しつつ抗腫瘍活性を維持することを明らかにした。機能的には、CYH33とダパグリフロジンの併用がT1Dマウスの免疫抑制性腫瘍微小環境を改善し、インターフェロン-αおよびインターフェロン-γ応答関連遺伝子セットの上調とID8腫瘍におけるCD8+ T細胞浸潤の有意な増加が認められた。さらに、この併用は抗PD-1抗体と相乗的に抗腫瘍効果をさらに増強した。
items.key_takeaway_ja: ダパグリフロジンは、1型糖尿病マウスにおいてCYH33誘発性高血糖を軽減しつつ抗腫瘍免疫を維持し、抗PD-1抗体との併用により抗腫瘍効果を相乗的に増強する。
items.why_matters_ja: CYH33は日本においてPIK3CA変異を有する卵巣明細胞癌の治療に承認されているが、高血糖というオンターゲット有害事象が臨床応用を制限している。本結果は、PI3K阻害薬の臨床使用を最適化し、代謝介入による腫瘍免疫微小環境の調節を示す新たな戦略を提供する。

items.title: GLP-1 receptor agonist therapy and incident atrial fibrillation in non-diabetic adults with obesity and chronic kidney disease: a propensity matched cohort study.
items.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Obesity and chronic kidney disease (CKD) are potent risk factors for atrial fibrillation (AF), yet whether GLP-1 receptor agonists (GLP-1RAs) prevent incident AF in non-diabetic adults with obesity and CKD is unexamined. We assessed whether GLP-1RA therapy reduces 1-year AF incidence in this cardiorenal phenotype.
METHODS: Using the TriNetX US Collaborative Network (66 healthcare organizations), we conducted a retrospective target trial emulation of non-diabetic adults aged 18 or older with obesity and CKD stages 3-5 diagnosed 2021-2024. Patients receiving semaglutide, liraglutide, or tirzepatide (n = 10,985) were compared with unexposed patients (n = 94,527). After propensity score matching, 7326 patients remained per cohort. The primary outcome was incident AF at 1 year; secondary outcomes included AF subtypes, ventricular tachyarrhythmias, and all-cause hospitalization. Cox models generated hazard ratios (HRs); sensitivity analyses extended follow-up to 2-3 years with landmark analyses.
RESULTS: At 1 year, GLP-1RA use was associated with significantly lower incident AF (1.63% vs. 2.62%; HR 0.655, 95% CI 0.508-0.844; p = 0.001), a 34.5% relative risk reduction. Reductions were consistent for paroxysmal (HR 0.586), persistent (HR 0.482), and longstanding persistent AF (HR 0.527; all p < 0.05); permanent AF was non-significant at 1 year. Ventricular tachyarrhythmias (HR 0.556; p = 0.002) and hospitalization (HR 0.668; p < 0.001) were also significantly reduced. Benefits persisted across 2- and 3-year follow-up and remained consistent in landmark analyses.
CONCLUSIONS: In non-diabetic adults with obesity and CKD, GLP-1RA therapy was associated with significant, durable reductions in incident AF, ventricular arrhythmias, and hospitalization. These findings are consistent with a possible cardiorenal benefit and support prioritizing this phenotype for dedicated randomized trials.
items.authors: Hassan Abdulraheem, Okorigba Efeturi, Grace Chilaka, Otabor Emmanuel, Osineye Busayo, Olayiwola Olalekan, Oyeleye Tutuola, Amin Parthiv
items.summary_ja: TriNetX US Collaborative Network（66医療機関）のデータを用いた後方視的ターゲットトライアルエミュレーション。2021〜2024年に診断された、肥満を伴うCKD 3〜5期の非糖尿病成人（18歳以上）において、GLP-1受容体作動薬（セマグルチド、リラグルチド、tirzepatide）が1年間の新規心房細動（AF）発生を抑制するかを評価した。傾向スコアマッチング後、コホートごとに7,326例が比較対象となった。主要アウトカムは1年時点の新規AF発生、副次アウトカムはAFサブタイプ、心室性頻拍性不整脈、全原因入院であった。
items.key_takeaway_ja: 肥満を伴うCKDの非糖尿病成人において、GLP-1受容体作動薬の使用は1年時点の新規AF発生（HR 0.655）、心室性頻拍性不整脈（HR 0.556）、全原因入院（HR 0.668）の有意かつ持続的な減少と関連していた。
items.why_matters_ja: 肥満とCKDはAFの強力なリスク因子であるが、この心腎フェノタイプにおいてGLP-1受容体作動薬が新規AFを予防するかは未検証であった。本結果は、このフェノタイプに対する専用のランダム化試験を優先すべきことを支持する。
items.study_type_ja: 後方視的ターゲットトライアルエミュレーション（傾向スコアマッチングコホート研究）
items.endpoints_ja: 主要アウトカム：1年時点の新規心房細動（AF）発生。副次アウトカム：AFサブタイプ（発作性、持続性、長期持続性、恒常性）、心室性頻拍性不整脈、全原因入院。
items.endpoint_results_ja: 1年時点の新規AF：GLP-1RA群 1.63% vs 非暴露群 2.62%；HR 0.655, 95% CI 0.508-0.844; p = 0.001。発作性AF：HR 0.586。持続性AF：HR 0.482。長期持続性AF：HR 0.527（いずれもp < 0.05）。恒常性AF：1年時点で有意差なし。心室性頻拍性不整脈：HR 0.556; p = 0.002。全原因入院：HR 0.668; p < 0.001。

items.title: Periconceptional and early-pregnancy exposure to SGLT2 inhibitors and congenital malformations: a systematic review and meta-analysis.
items.abstract:
PURPOSE: Sodium-glucose cotransporter-2 (SGLT2) inhibitors are increasingly prescribed to women of reproductive age for type 2 diabetes and cardiorenal protection, and are commonly continued through the periconceptional period until pregnancy is recognized. Human safety data on inadvertent first-trimester exposure remain scarce, creating substantial clinical uncertainty.
METHODS: We systematically searched PubMed/MEDLINE, Embase, and CENTRAL from inception to 15 May 2026 for observational cohort studies comparing early-pregnancy or preconception exposure to SGLT2 inhibitors with active antidiabetic comparators among women with type 2 diabetes. Adjusted risk ratios (RRs) were pooled using random-effects meta-analysis.
RESULTS: Three cohorts, including 669 SGLT2 inhibitor-exposed pregnancies, were eligible. In the prespecified insulin-comparator analysis, SGLT2 inhibitor exposure was not associated with major congenital malformations (RR 0.94, 95% CI 0.68-1.29) or cardiac malformations (RR 0.97, 95% CI 0.64-1.48). The inclusion of a preconception sulfonylurea comparator cohort yielded a similar estimate for major congenital malformations (RR 0.98, 95% CI 0.74-1.29). In a Korean cohort, exposure during gestational weeks 4-10 was associated with congenital heart defects (RR 2.79, 95% CI 1.16-7.06).
CONCLUSIONS: Based on the limited observational evidence available, early SGLT2 inhibitor exposure was not associated with an increased risk of overall major congenital or cardiac malformations; however, the estimates were imprecise and could not rule out clinically important increases in risk. Certainty of the evidence was low to very low because of residual confounding, live-birth selection, heterogeneous exposure definitions, and few exposed events. A possible timing-specific cardiac signal requires replication.
items.authors: Dutta Deep, Mahajan Kunal, Gupta Gunjan, Sharma Meha, Sugandha Swati, Kamrul-Hasan A B M
items.summary_ja: SGLT2阻害薬の周産期・妊娠初期曝露と先天奇形との関連を評価した系統的レビューおよびメタアナリシス。観察コホート研究3件（SGLT2阻害薬曝露妊娠669例）が対象となった。インスリン比較群の事前指定解析では、主要先天奇形（RR 0.94, 95% CI 0.68-1.29）および心奇形（RR 0.97, 95% CI 0.64-1.48）との関連は認められなかった。スルホニルウレア比較群を含む解析でも主要先天奇形の推定値は類似（RR 0.98, 95% CI 0.74-1.29）。一方、韓国コホートでは妊娠4〜10週での曝露が先天性心疾患と関連（RR 2.79, 95% CI 1.16-7.06）した。
items.key_takeaway_ja: 限られた観察疫学的証拠に基づき、SGLT2阻害薬の早期曝露は全体的な主要先天奇形や心奇形のリスク増加とは関連しなかったが、推定値は不正確であり、臨床的に重要なリスク増加を排除できなかった。時期特異的な心臓シグナルの再現性が求められる。
items.why_matters_ja: SGLT2阻害薬は生殖年齢の女性に2型糖尿病や心腎保護目的で増加傾向にあり、妊娠が判明するまで周産期に継続されることが多い。意図しない第1三半期曝露に関するヒト安全性データは依然として乏しく、臨床的不確実性が大きい。
items.study_type_ja: 系統的レビューおよびメタアナリシス（観察コホート研究を対象）
items.endpoints_ja: 主要先天奇形、心奇形、先天性心疾患（妊娠4〜10週曝露の時期特異的解析）

items.title: Dapagliflozin in phenotypically stratified HFpEF without myocardial fibrosis: the STADIA-HFpEF randomized crossover trial.
items.abstract:
AIMS: Heart failure with preserved ejection fraction(HFpEF) is characterized by increased diastolic left ventricular(LV) stiffness resulting from variable contributions of myocardial extracellular matrix(ECM) remodeling and titin-based cardiomyocyte stiffness. Sodium-glucose cotransporter-2 inhibitors(SGLT2i) improved cardiomyocyte distensibility, inflammation, and oxidative stress in experimental and human HFpEF myocardium. We investigated whether dapagliflozin improves LV distensibility in phenotypically stratified HFpEF patients without significant myocardial fibrosis.
METHODS: STADIA-HFpEF was a 34-week, randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled crossover trial. HFpEF patients underwent multi-level phenotypic stratification including cardiac magnetic resonance imaging to exclude structural cardiomyopathies and significant myocardial ECM remodeling. Participants were randomized to dapagliflozin 10 mg or placebo for two 13-week treatment periods separated by an 8-week washout.The co-primary endpoints were changes in E/e'/LV end-diastolic volume index(LVEDVi) and mean LV e', reflecting LV distensibility and relaxation. Secondary endpoints included echocardiographic variables, quality of life, 6-minute walk distance, and inflammatory biomarkers.
RESULTS: Between February 2020 and October 2022, 32 patients were randomized and 29 completed the study protocol. Median age was 73(68-76) years including 28 women(88%). Dapagliflozin did not significantly modify E/e'/LVEDVi compared with placebo 0.24 (0.20-0.32) to 0.26 (0.22-0.34) vs. 0.23 (0.22-0.29) to 0.25 (0.21-0.31); p=0.370 nor did it change mean LV e' 6.2 (5.6-7.5) to 6.2 (5.7-7.1) vs. 6.6 (5.6-7.4) to 6.7 (5.4-7.5); p=0.448. Most secondary outcomes were neutral. However, an isolated improvement in LA conduit strain and numerical reductions in inflammatory biomarkers were observed during dapagliflozin treatment.
CONCLUSIONS: In phenotypically stratified HFpEF patients without significant myocardial fibrosis, dapagliflozin did not improve LV distensibility or relaxation. An isolated improvement in LA conduit strain and numerical reductions in inflammatory biomarkers were observed; however, these exploratory findings require confirmation in larger studies.
items.authors: Scheffer Mariëlle, van Maarschalkerwaart Willemijn, Dong Chaohui, Landzaat Jochem W D, Nedenyi Fanni, Delalat Simin, Sultana Innas, Jarkas Oliver
items.summary_ja: STADIA-HFpEFは、心筋線維化が有意でない表現型層別化されたHFpEF患者において、ダパグリフロジンが左室(LV)拡張性を改善するかを評価した34週間のランダム化二重盲検プラセボ対照クロスオーバー試験である。32例がランダム化され、29例がプロトコルを完了した（中央年齢73歳、女性88%）。共同一次エンドポイントであるE/e'/LVEDViの変化および平均LV e'の変化はいずれも有意な改善を認めなかった。二次エンドポイントの多くは中立であったが、LA conduit strainの孤立した改善と炎症性バイオマーカーの数値的減少が観察された。
items.key_takeaway_ja: 心筋線維化が有意でない表現型層別化されたHFpEF患者において、ダパグリフロジンはLV拡張性（E/e'/LVEDVi）や弛緩（平均LV e'）を有意に改善しなかった。
items.why_matters_ja: HFpEFは心筋細胞外基質(ECM)リモデリングとチチンベースの心筋細胞剛性の異なる寄与によって特徴づけられ、SGLT2iが心筋細胞の伸展性を改善する可能性が実験的・臨床的に示唆されていた。本試験は、線維化を除外したHFpEFサブグループにおいてSGLT2iのLV拡張性への効果を層別化して評価した点で意義があるが、主要エンドポイントでは効果が確認されず、SGLT2iのHFpEFにおける作用機序は線維化の有無や表現型によって異なる可能性を示唆している。
items.study_type_ja: ランダム化二重盲検プラセボ対照クロスオーバー試験
items.endpoints_ja: 共同一次エンドポイント：E/e'/LVEDViの変化、平均LV e'の変化。二次エンドポイント：エコー心図変数、生活の質(QOL)、6分歩行距離、炎症性バイオマーカー。
items.endpoint_results_ja: E/e'/LVEDVi：ダパグリフロジン群 0.24 (0.20-0.32) → 0.26 (0.22-0.34) vs プラセボ群 0.23 (0.22-0.29) → 0.25 (0.21-0.31)；p=0.370。平均LV e'：ダパグリフロジン群 6.2 (5.6-7.5) → 6.2 (5.7-7.1) vs プラセボ群 6.6 (5.6-7.4) → 6.7 (5.4-7.5)；p=0.448。LA conduit strain：孤立した改善（具体的な数値は抄録に記載なし）。炎症性バイオマーカー：数値的減少（具体的な数値は抄録に記載なし）。

items.title: Diagnostic challenges of masked arginine vasopressin deficiency in neurosarcoidosis complicated by sodium-glucose cotransporter 2 inhibitor use.
items.abstract: A wide variety of endocrine disorders caused by sarcoidosis have been reported to date. We report the case of an 82-year-old male patient who presented with hypercalcemia and anterior pituitary hormone deficiency at the time of his sarcoidosis diagnosis and was subsequently diagnosed with arginine vasopressin deficiency (AVP-D) 6 months after the initiation of glucocorticoid therapy. Magnetic resonance imaging revealed an enlarged pituitary gland, thickened pituitary stalk, and loss of the posterior pituitary bright spot, raising the suspicion of hypothalamic-pituitary sarcoidosis. Despite improvement in hypercalcemia, anterior pituitary function, and pituitary enlargement and stalk thickening with glucocorticoid therapy, subjective symptoms of dry mouth and polyuria gradually became apparent several months after the start of treatment. While the characteristic hypotonic polyuria of AVP-D was not prominent, we surmised that these typical clinical features were masked by adrenal insufficiency, chronic kidney disease (CKD), and concurrent use of a sodium-glucose cotransporter 2 (SGLT2) inhibitor for type 2 diabetes. This case highlights the fact that the typical presentation of AVP-D can be masked by concurrent SGLT2 inhibitor use and CKD, emphasizing careful assessment of water balance in such patients.
items.authors: Nonaka Ryohei, Tanaka Katsuhiro, Tomimoto Akemi, Nagai Yukie, Nomura Takuya, Shibata Hirotaka
items.summary_ja: 82歳男性の神経サルコイドーシス症例。サルコイドーシス診断時に高カルシウム血症と前葉ホルモン欠損を認め、グルココルチコイド療法開始6か月後にアルギニンバソプレシン欠損（AVP-D）と診断された。MRIで下垂体肥大、下垂体茎肥厚、後葉高信号消失を認めた。グルココルチコイド療法により高カルシウム血症・前葉機能・下垂体肥大は改善したが、数か月後に口渇と多尿が徐々に出現した。AVP-Dに特徴的な低浸透圧性多尿は顕著でなく、副腎不全、慢性腎臓病（CKD）、および2型糖尿病に対するSGLT2阻害薬の併用により典型的な臨床所見がマスクされていたと推測された。
items.key_takeaway_ja: SGLT2阻害薬の併用とCKDによりAVP-Dの典型的な臨床所見（低浸透圧性多尿）がマスクされうるため、こうした患者では水分バランスの慎重な評価が重要である。
items.why_matters_ja: 神経サルコイドーシスに伴うAVP-Dは、SGLT2阻害薬やCKDなどの併存疾患・薬剤により診断が困難になり得る。本症例は、これらの要因がAVP-Dの典型的な臨床像を隠蔽し、診断を遅らせる可能性を示しており、臨床現場での水分バランス評価の重要性を強調している。

items.title: Qualitative Exit Interviews to Characterize the Positive Treatment Experiences of Patients in the Phase III Trial of Orforglipron Versus Oral Semaglutide for the Treatment of Type 2 Diabetes.
items.abstract:
BACKGROUND AND OBJECTIVE: There is an unmet need for effective and well-tolerated oral formulations of glucagon-like peptide 1 receptor agonists for the management of type 2 diabetes. Orforglipron and oral semaglutide are two oral glucagon-like peptide 1 receptor agonists evaluated in the ACHIEVE-3 clinical trial (NCT06045221). These novel treatments have the means to achieve clinically meaningful glycemic control and weight reduction, which may result in substantial positive changes in patients' daily lives. The objective of this study was to conduct exit interviews following the ACHIEVE-3 trial to characterize positive treatment experiences and outcomes, beyond glycated hemoglobin and weight reduction, reported by patients living with type 2 diabetes who received oral glucagon-like peptide 1 receptor agonist-based treatments.
METHODS: Qualitative interviews were conducted across ten clinical sites within the USA with patients who had enrolled in ACHIEVE-3 and completed at least 3 months of treatment. Interviews were conducted in English or Spanish, audio-recorded, and transcribed. Transcripts were analyzed to identify and categorize positive treatment benefits reported during the interviews. Descriptive statistics were used to characterize the sample.
RESULTS: Sixty patients completed the qualitative exit interviews. Patients had a mean age of 59.1 years (standard deviation [SD] = 10.3), and almost half were female (n = 28, 46.7%). Patients had been diagnosed with type 2 diabetes for a mean of 8.5 years (SD = 5.7). By the end of the study, patients reduced their glycated hemoglobin by 1.6% (SD = 1.3) from a baseline of 8.3% and lost a mean of 4.7 kg (SD = 6.8) from a baseline of 96.0 kg. All patients reported being satisfied with the trial medication (n = 59/59), were likely to recommend the treatment to other patients, and all but one were willing to continue taking the medication. As expected, the two most important and most frequently reported positive changes were controlled glycated hemoglobin (n = 53, 88.3%) and weight reduction (n = 50, 83.3%). Other common spontaneously reported positive concepts included increased perceived energy (n = 28, 46.7%), reduced appetite and cravings (n = 23, 38.3%), improved exercise/movement (n = 18, 30.0%), and psychological improvements (n = 18, 30.0%). Additional positive changes included increased confidence/self-esteem, improved diet and eating habits, improved sleep, and improved or a lack of deterioration in vision. All reported positive changes were considered meaningful by patients.
CONCLUSIONS: The current study explored the positive experiences of patients taking an oral glucagon-like peptide 1 receptor agonist in the ACHIEVE-3 trial beyond traditional clinical benefits, such as glycemic control and weight reduction. The positive changes identified may be suitable targets for future clinical trial clinical outcome assessment endpoint strategies to help differentiate treatments and in clinical practices to classify patients' experiences.
items.authors: Boye Kristina, Cutts Katelyn, Zhao Youna, Steere Eliza, Gelhorn Heather
items.summary_ja: ACHIEVE-3試験（NCT06045221、Orforglipron vs 経口Semaglutide、2型糖尿病のPhase III試験）に参加し、少なくとも3ヶ月の治療を完了した患者を対象に、米国10施設で定性退出インタビューを実施した。HbA1cおよび体重減少以外の、経口GLP-1受容体作動薬による治療のポジティブな体験とアウトカムを特徴づけることを目的とした。
items.key_takeaway_ja: 最も頻繁に報告されたポジティブな変化はHbA1cのコントロール（n=53, 88.3%）と体重減少（n=50, 83.3%）であり、次いでエネルギー感の向上（n=28, 46.7%）、食欲・渇望の減少（n=23, 38.3%）、運動・活動の改善（n=18, 30.0%）、心理的改善（n=18, 30.0%）が報告された。全患者が試験薬に満足しており（n=59/59）、1名を除き継続服用を希望した。
items.why_matters_ja: 本研究で特定されたポジティブな変化は、将来の臨床試験における臨床アウトカムアセスメント（COA）エンドポイント戦略の適したターゲットとなりうる。治療の差別化や臨床実践における患者体験の分類に活用可能である。

items.endpoints_ja: HbA1cおよび体重減少以外のポジティブな治療体験・アウトカムの定性評価（HbA1cコントロール、体重減少、エネルギー感の向上、食欲・渇望の減少、運動・活動の改善、心理的改善、自信・自尊心の向上、食事・食事習慣の改善、睡眠の改善、視力の改善または悪化なし）

items.title: Real-world, digital-first delivery of GLP-1 receptor agonist therapy in women.
items.abstract: Glucagon-like peptide-1 receptor agonists (GLP-1RAs) have demonstrated substantial weight reduction and cardiometabolic benefit in randomized trials; however, prospective implementation evidence from digital care models and female sex community populations remains limited. Here we report outcomes from an observational study of 8,127 women initiating GLP-1RA therapy (99.8% tirzepatide) through a structured digital program incorporating mandatory biochemical monitoring, weekly video-supported follow-up and clinician-guided dose titration in the UK. Mean weight reduction was 16.1 kg (95% confidence interval 15.9 to 16.2; P < 0.001), representing 15.5% of baseline weight; 83.1% achieved ≥10% and 22.4% achieved ≥20% weight loss, with consistent responses across age, baseline weight and socioeconomic strata. Among participants with paired biomarker data, mean glycated hemoglobin decreased by 3.3 mmol mol-1 (95% confidence interval 3.1 to 3.4; P < 0.001), normalizing in 84.5% of those with baseline diabetes-range values and 96.3% with prediabetes, and lipid parameters improved significantly (reductions in total cholesterol of 0.77 mmol l-1, low-density lipoprotein cholesterol of 0.61 mmol l-1 and triglycerides of 0.47 mmol l-1). Retention was 91.4% at 6 months, with no serious treatment-related adverse events. These findings support the feasibility of delivering structured, digitally enabled obesity pharmacotherapy at scale and provide prospective real-world implementation evidence for this care model. Interpretation is limited by the observational design, absence of a comparator group, self-pay population and 6-month follow-up.
items.authors: Deanfield John, Wong Jamie Lai Chun, Katsoulis Michail, Deanfield Emma, Thakkar Raj, Patel Riyaz, Joy Rachael, Noble Matthew
items.summary_ja: 英国において、構造化デジタルプログラム（必須の生化学的モニタリング、週次ビデオ支援フォローアップ、臨床医主導の用量調整）を通じてGLP-1受容体作動薬（99.8%がtirzepatide）治療を開始した8,127名の女性を対象とした観察研究。平均体重減少は16.1 kg（ベースライン体重の15.5%）であり、83.1%が10%以上、22.4%が20%以上の体重減少を達成した。HbA1cは平均3.3 mmol/mol低下し、糖尿病域のベースライン値を有した参加者の84.5%、糖尿病予備群の96.3%で正常化を達成した。脂質パラメータも有意に改善し、6ヶ月時の継続率は91.4%、重大な治療関連有害事象は認められなかった。
items.key_takeaway_ja: 構造化デジタルプログラムによるGLP-1受容体作動薬治療は、女性集団において大規模に実施可能であり、有意な体重減少と心代謝的改善をもたらす。
items.why_matters_ja: デジタルケアモデルおよび女性集団におけるGLP-1受容体作動薬治療のprospective実装証拠が限られていた中、本研究はデジタルファーストの肥満薬物療法を大規模に提供することの現実可能性を示し、このケアモデルに対するprospective実世界実装証拠を提供する。
items.study_type_ja: 観察研究（prospective、実世界）
items.endpoints_ja: 体重減少量、体重減少率（≥10%、≥20%達成率）、HbA1c変化量、HbA1c正常化率、脂質パラメータ（総コレステロール、LDLコレステロール、トリグリセリド）の変化量、6ヶ月時継続率、重大な治療関連有害事象
items.endpoint_results_ja: 平均体重減少: 16.1 kg（95% CI 15.9〜16.2; P < 0.001）、ベースライン体重の15.5%。≥10%体重減少達成率: 83.1%。≥20%体重減少達成率: 22.4%。HbA1c平均低下: 3.3 mmol/mol（95% CI 3.1〜3.4; P < 0.001）。HbA1c正常化率: 糖尿病域ベースライン値で84.5%、糖尿病予備群で96.3%。総コレステロール低下: 0.77 mmol/l。LDLコレステロール低下: 0.61 mmol/l。トリグリセリド低下: 0.47 mmol/l。6ヶ月時継続率: 91.4%。重大な治療関連有害事象: なし。

items.title: SGLT2 inhibitors and cardiovascular outcomes in patients with moderate-to-severe psoriasis receiving biologic therapy: A propensity score-matched cohort study.
items.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Patients with moderate-to-severe psoriasis have an increased risk of cardiovascular disease. Sodium-glucose cotransporter 2 (SGLT2) inhibitors provide cardiovascular benefits, but their association with cardiovascular outcomes in patients with psoriasis remains insufficiently studied.
METHODS: We conducted a retrospective cohort study using the global TriNetX research network. Patients older than 40 years with plaque psoriasis receiving biologic therapy were categorized according to SGLT2 inhibitor use. Propensity score matching was performed to balance demographic characteristics, cardiovascular risk factors, kidney disease, and concomitant antidiabetic medications.
RESULTS: After matching, 2,016 patients were included in each cohort. SGLT2 inhibitor use was associated with a significantly lower incidence of acute myocardial infarction (HR, 0.601; 95%CI, 0.426-0.849), stroke (HR, 0.553; 95%CI, 0.381-0.804), heart failure (HR, 0.751; 95%CI, 0.581-0.970), peripheral artery disease (HR, 0.648; 95%CI, 0.470-0.894), and angina pectoris (HR, 0.601; 95%CI, 0.404-0.894). No significant association was observed for transient ischemic attack.
CONCLUSIONS: SGLT2 inhibitor use was associated with favorable cardiovascular outcomes in patients with moderate-to-severe psoriasis receiving biologic therapy. These findings support further prospective investigation of SGLT2 inhibitors as a potential strategy for cardiovascular risk reduction in this population.
items.authors: Gotor-Rivera A, Hernández Sánchez J, Chamorro Jiménez E, García Rivera E, Ortiz Romero P L, Rivera-Diaz R
items.summary_ja: 中等症〜重症の乾癬（乾板状乾癬）で生物学的製剤治療を受けている患者において、SGLT2阻害薬の使用と心血管アウトカムの関連を、TriNetX研究ネットワークを用いた後方視コホート研究で検討した。プロパensity score matchingにより各コホート2,016例をマッチングし、SGLT2阻害薬使用群は急性心筋梗塞、脳卒中、心不全、末梢動脈疾患、狭心症の発症率が有意に低かった。一過性脳虚血発作には有意な関連は認められなかった。
items.key_takeaway_ja: 中等症〜重症の乾癬で生物学的製剤治療中の患者において、SGLT2阻害薬の使用は心血管アウトカムの改善と関連していた。
items.why_matters_ja: 中等症〜重症の乾癬患者は心血管疾患のリスクが上昇しており、SGLT2阻害薬がこの集団における心血管リスク低減の戦略となり得る可能性を示唆する。ただし、本結果は後方視研究であり、前向き研究での検証が今後の課題である。

items.title: GLP-1 receptor agonist treatment and cardiovascular outcomes following aortic valve replacement: a nationwide observational study.
items.abstract:
BACKGROUND: GLP-1 receptor agonists reduce major adverse cardiovascular events among patients with diabetes, overweight, and obesity. Whether these benefits extend to patients undergoing aortic valve replacement (AVR) for severe aortic stenosis (AS) remains unknown. Thus, we investigated the association between GLP-1 receptor agonist treatment and cardiovascular outcomes after AVR.
METHODS: Nationwide population-based cohort study including consecutive patients with severe AS undergoing TAVI or SAVR in Western Denmark between January, 2016 and April, 2022. Patients were followed until death, emigration, crossover, or end of follow up on May 12, 2026. Propensity score-matching was performed to balance confounding. The primary outcome was a composite of all-cause mortality, heart failure hospitalization, or aortic valve reoperation. Secondary outcomes included all-cause mortality, heart failure hospitalization, aortic valve reoperation, with analyses accounting for the competing risk of death.
RESULTS: Among 5259 eligible patients undergoing AVR, 292 propensity score-matched patients were included in the final analyses. During a mean follow up of 4.8±2.4 years, GLP-1 receptor agonist treatment was associated with a lower risk of the primary composite outcome compared with controls (HR 0.69, 95%CI 0.50-0.96, p=0.029). GLP-1 receptor agonist treatment was also associated with lower risk of all-cause mortality (HR 0.66, 95%CI 0.46-0.95, p=0.025). In competing risk analyses accounting for death, lower risks were observed for heart failure hospitalization (HR 0.67, 95%CI 0.48-0.93, p=0.018), and aortic valve reoperation (HR 0.69, 95%CI 0.49-0.98, p=0.037).
CONCLUSION: Treatment with GLP-1 receptor agonists was associated with lower risk of cardiovascular outcomes including mortality following AVR among patients with severe AS.
items.authors: Krasniqi Lytfi, Hamandi Mohanad, Mortensen Poul Erik, Nissen Henrik, Pellikka Patricia A, Borlaug Barry A, Gerke Oke, Haujir Amal
items.summary_ja: 重度大動脈弁狭窄症に対してTAVIまたはSAVRを受けた患者において、GLP-1受容体作動薬の心血管転帰への影響を、デンマーク西部の全国規模の人口ベースコホート研究（2016年1月〜2022年4月）で検討した。プロパティスコアマッチングにより交絡を調整し、平均4.8±2.4年の追跡期間で転帰を評価した。
items.key_takeaway_ja: GLP-1受容体作動薬の投与は、AVR後の主要複合転帰（全死因死亡、心不全入院、大動脈弁再手術）のリスク低下（HR 0.69, 95%CI 0.50-0.96, p=0.029）および全死因死亡のリスク低下（HR 0.66, 95%CI 0.46-0.95, p=0.025）と関連した。
items.why_matters_ja: GLP-1受容体作動薬の心血管保護効果は糖尿病・肥満患者で確立されているが、重度ASに対するAVR後の患者への適用は不明であった。本研究は、AVR後の患者におけるGLP-1受容体作動薬の潜在的な心血管保護効果を示唆し、この集団での治療戦略の検討を促す。

items.title: Pharmacy students' knowledge and attitudes regarding GLP-1 receptor agonist adverse effects in obesity management: a cross-sectional study.
items.abstract: Glucagon-like peptide-1 receptor agonists (GLP-1 RAs) are important therapeutic options for obesity and type 2 diabetes mellitus. Despite their increasing use, safety concerns remain, and pharmacy students' knowledge of their adverse effects is unclear. This study evaluated pharmacy students' knowledge and attitudes regarding GLP-1 RA adverse effects in obesity management. A cross-sectional questionnaire-based study was conducted among undergraduate Doctor of Pharmacy (Pharm.D.) students (1st-7th year) at Umm Al-Qura University, Saudi Arabia, between November and December 2025. A newly developed questionnaire, reviewed by two experts and pilot-tested among 10 students, assessed 17 knowledge and five attitude items covering indications, mechanisms, adverse effects, and clinical scenarios. Of 1,118 eligible students, 296 completed the survey (response rate: 26.5%). Descriptive statistics and multivariable regression analyses were performed using RStudio (version 2024.9.1.394). Among participants (63.9% male), the mean knowledge score was 7.6 ± 4.0/17. Most agreed that adverse effects significantly impact clinical use (59.4%) and supported further education on less common side effects (61.1%). Nausea was the most frequently recognized adverse effect (59.1%), whereas thyroid C-cell tumors observed in rodent studies (25.0%) and diabetic retinopathy complications (36.5%) were less commonly identified. Only 37.2% correctly recognized that hypoglycemia is uncommon with GLP-1 RA monotherapy. Higher knowledge scores were significantly associated with greater confidence in knowledge (OR = 1.11, 95% CI: 1.06-1.17; p < 0.001) and stronger endorsement of further education on less common side effects (OR = 1.11, 95% CI: 1.06-1.18; p < 0.001), whereas gender and academic year were not significant predictors of any attitude item. Pharmacy students demonstrated limited knowledge but generally positive attitudes regarding GLP-1 RA safety. These findings highlight the need to strengthen pharmacovigilance and evidence-based medication safety education within pharmacy curricula to improve clinical preparedness and patient counseling.
items.authors: Khojah Alaa A, Gazzaz Malaz J, Aldurdunji Mohammed M, Safiraldeen Ahmad E, Al-Qurashi Ibrahim R, Alhazmi Mohammad A, Abdalla Ashraf N, Alqurashi Roaya S
items.summary_ja: サウジアラビアのUmm Al-Qura大学にて、Pharm.D.学部学生（1〜7年次）を対象に、GLP-1受容体作動薬（GLP-1 RA）の肥満管理における有害事象に関する知識と態度を評価した横断的質問紙調査。2025年11〜12月に実施し、対象1,118名中296名が回答（回答率26.5%）。知識スコアは17項目、態度は5項目で構成。平均知識スコアは7.6 ± 4.0/17であった。最も多く認識された有害事象は悪心（59.1%）であり、甲状腺C細胞腫瘍（25.0%）や糖尿病性網膜症合併症（36.5%）は認識率が低かった。GLP-1 RA単独療法で低血糖は稀であること正しく認識したのは37.2%のみ。知識スコアが高いほど知識への自信（OR = 1.11, 95% CI: 1.06-1.17; p < 0.001）および稀な副作用に関する追加教育への支持（OR = 1.11, 95% CI: 1.06-1.18; p < 0.001）が有意に高かった。性別と学年は態度項目の有意な予測因子ではなかった。
items.key_takeaway_ja: 薬学学生はGLP-1 RAの安全性に関して知識は限定的であるが、態度は概ね肯定的であった。
items.why_matters_ja: これらの結果は、臨床的準備と患者カウンセリングの向上のため、薬学カリキュラム内での薬物警戒（pharmacovigilance）およびエビデンスベースの薬剤安全性教育を強化する必要性を浮き彫りにしている。

items.endpoints_ja: GLP-1 RA有害事象に関する知識スコア（17項目）、態度（5項目）、個別有害事象の認識率、知識スコアと態度項目との関連（多変量回帰分析）

items.title: GLP-1 receptor agonist use and contrast-associated acute kidney injury after contrast-enhanced CT and CT angiography in adults with type 2 diabetes and chronic kidney disease: a propensity score-matched cohort study.
items.abstract:
AIMS: To examine whether glucagon-like peptide-1 receptor agonist (GLP-1 RA) use is associated with contrast-associated acute kidney injury (CA-AKI) after contrast-enhanced computed tomography (CE-CT) or computed tomographic angiography (CTA) in adults with type 2 diabetes and chronic kidney disease (CKD).
METHODS: We conducted a TriNetX retrospective cohort study of adults with type 2 diabetes and CKD who underwent CE-CT or CTA from January 2020 to January 2025. GLP-1 RA use was defined by a prescription within six months before imaging. The primary outcome was a new acute kidney injury diagnosis within three days. Separate 1:1 propensity score-matched analyses were conducted for CE-CT and CTA, with eGFR-stratified and sensitivity analyses.
RESULTS: After matching, the CE-CT and CTA cohorts included 6,995 and 3,285 pairs, respectively. CA-AKI occurred in 3.8% of GLP-1 RA users versus 4.5% of non-users after CE-CT (odds ratio [OR] 0.84, 95% confidence interval [CI] 0.71-0.99) and in 4.5% versus 6.1% after CTA (OR 0.74, 95% CI 0.59-0.92). The absolute risk differences were 0.7% points and 1.5% points, respectively. HbA1c remained imbalanced after matching. Negative-control outcomes were null, and eGFR-stratified associations were inconsistent between cohorts.
CONCLUSIONS: GLP-1 RA use was associated with a lower observed risk of CA-AKI after CE-CT and CTA in adults with type 2 diabetes and CKD. Residual HbA1c imbalance and the observational design limit causal interpretation; prospective studies using creatinine-based outcomes are needed.
items.authors: Chang Yu, Chi Kuan-Yu, Lin Hong-Min
items.summary_ja: 2型糖尿病および慢性腎臓病（CKD）を有する成人において、造影増強CT（CE-CT）またはCT血管造影（CTA）施行後の造影剤関連急性腎障害（CA-AKI）とGLP-1受容体作動薬（GLP-1 RA）使用との関連を評価したTriNetXを用いた後方視コホート研究である。2020年1月から2025年1月までにCE-CTまたはCTAを施行した対象者を対象とし、画像検査の6か月前の処方に基づきGLP-1 RA使用を定義した。主評価項目は3日以内の新規急性腎障害診断であり、CE-CTとCTAそれぞれについて1:1プロパensityスコアマッチング解析を実施した。
items.key_takeaway_ja: 2型糖尿病およびCKDを有する成人において、GLP-1 RA使用はCE-CTおよびCTA施行後のCA-AKIの観察リスク低下と関連していた。ただし、HbA1cの残存不均衡と観察研究デザインのため因果解釈には限界がある。
items.why_matters_ja: 2型糖尿病およびCKDを有する患者は造影剤関連急性腎障害のリスクが高く、GLP-1 RAはこの集団で広く使用されている。造影検査の適応判断や腎保護戦略の策定において、GLP-1 RA使用とCA-AKIリスクの関連を把握することは臨床的に重要である。

items.title: Recurrent In-Stent Restenosis and Accelerated Neoatherosclerosis in a Middle-Aged Woman With High Inflammatory Burden.
items.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Recurrent in-stent restenosis (ISR) driven by accelerated neoatherosclerosis and high residual inflammatory risk remains a formidable clinical challenge.
CASE SUMMARY: A 50-year-old noncompliant, obese, diabetic woman presented with recurrent multivessel ISR. Intravascular ultrasound confirmed intrastent thin-cap fibroatheromas. Despite multiple drug-coated balloon interventions, intensive lipid-lowering via inclisiran, and glycemic control with tirzepatide, she suffered relentless ISR driven by highly elevated interleukin-6. She received advanced anti-inflammatory therapies and was referred for bypass surgery.
DISCUSSION: Literature highlights that targeting upstream inflammation is critical when standard therapies fail to halt malignant neoatherosclerosis. This case interests readers by demonstrating compliance optimization via long-acting agents and navigating advanced anti-inflammatory pathways (colchicine escalation, canakinumab) for refractory ISR.
TAKE-HOME MESSAGES: Biomarkers like interleukin-6 must be evaluated in refractory ISR; persistent residual inflammation warrants advanced anti-inflammatory therapies or early surgical revascularization.
items.authors: Li Wenhao, Han Wenqi, Wang Zhenyu
items.summary_ja: 50歳の非服薬遵守・肥満・糖尿病を有する女性で、加速性新動脈硬化症および高炎症負荷（IL-6高値）に起因する反復性多血管内ステント内再狭窄（ISR）を呈した。複数回の薬剤洗脱バルーン介入、インクリシランによる集学的脂質低下療法、チルゼパチドによる血糖管理にもかかわらず、ISRは持続した。最終的に高度な抗炎症療法（コルヒチン増量、カナキヌマブ）を施行し、バイパス手術へ紹介された。
items.key_takeaway_ja: 難治性ISRではIL-6などのバイオマーカーの評価が必須であり、持続する残存炎症に対しては高度な抗炎症療法または早期外科的血行再建が検討されるべきである。
items.why_matters_ja: 標準療法で悪性新動脈硬化症を抑制できない場合、上流の炎症を標的とすることが重要である。本症例は、長作用薬剤による服薬遵守の最適化と、難治性ISRに対する高度な抗炎症経路（コルヒチン増量、カナキヌマブ）のナビゲーションを実証している。
